description: This file defines an interface IEventFactory and a template class TraceFactoryType for creating message metadata and event objects within the WPEFramework's Messaging namespace. It appears to be part of a messaging or event handling system, providing factory methods for message creation with pooling mechanisms.

classes.name: IEventFactory
classes.description: An interface for creating message metadata and message objects, serving as a factory pattern for messaging components.

classes.name: TraceFactoryType
classes.description: A template class implementing IEventFactory, providing pooled creation of metadata and event objects for messaging, parameterized by METADATA and EVENT types.

methods.name: GetMetadata
methods.description: Returns a proxy to a metadata message object, retrieved from the metadata pool.

methods.name: GetMessage
methods.description: Returns a proxy to an event message object, retrieved from the event pool.
